# Inception
This project is about using Docker and system administation. The goal is to virtualise several Debian images by seting up them into a complete WordPress/MariaDB/NGINX system.

## Features
- Use only Debian images to setup all the containers.
- Set up NGINX with TLS v1.2 to get HTTPS protocol.
- Auto-configure WordPress at launch, setting up users and website requirements.
- MariaDB data base stored in VM's volume.
- `docker-compose` to build the entire system.
